messages:
Lina (platform): Quick sync — dashboard/telemetry needs a clear contract for reqID/span sampling so Console can show reliable p99/p50 by model_variant without exploding cardinality. Proposed minimal fields: request_id, span_id (when sampled), sampled boolean, sampling_bucket, sample_policy, route_key, model_variant. Thoughts?

Ajay (runtime): We can emit those headers from the edge: x-rw-reqid, x-rw-spanid, x-rw-sampled, x-rw-sampling-bucket, x-rw-sample-policy, x-rw-model-variant. Concern: request_id as a metric label is high-cardinality — dashboards must only roll up on low-card labels.

Sergio (sre): Agreed re: cardinality. Keep request_id out of metric labels. Use it only for logs/traces. For metrics expose sampling_bucket (low-card), route_key, model_variant, region. sampling_bucket enum: on, off, prob-0.01, canary.

Maya (platform-ux): Console wants to show: sampled_rate, sampled_latency (p50/p95/p99), overall_latency, and an indicator if exemplar->trace linkage exists. We rely on exemplar linking for drilldown. If exemplar missing, UI should show "trace not available (likely unsampled)" rather than an error.

Ajay (runtime): Implementation notes: sampling decision made at request ingress. For probabilistic/adaptive, we set sampled=1 for selected requests and include span_id. Also emit counters: rw.request.total{route_key,model_variant,sampling_bucket} and rw.request.sampled{...} so Console can compute rate. Histograms: rw.request.latency_ms with exemplars when sampled.

Lina (platform): Sounds good. Can we standardize the header format? Example proposal:

```
x-rw-reqid: 01c3a5b2f7
x-rw-spanid: a7d2c3
x-rw-sampled: 1
x-rw-sampling-bucket: prob-0.01
x-rw-sample-policy: adaptive
x-rw-sampling-v: 2
x-rw-model-variant: redwood-llama-8q
x-rw-route-key: embeddings.generate
```

Sergio (sre): Add x-rw-sampling-v (version) — needed so we can change algorithms without breaking dashboards. Also we should document deterministic sampling: hash(request_id) % 10000 < threshold to avoid burstiness.

Ajay (runtime): We'll implement sampling_v=2 which supports "adaptive" and "prob-X" buckets and will set sampling_bucket accordingly. Edge proxies will passthrough x-rw-* headers; they won't rewrite. We'll add unit tests + an integ test that verifies exemplar linking to trace_id when sampled.

Maya (platform-ux): On Console side: we'll accept rw.request.total and rw.request.sampled and compute sampled_pct. For latency histograms, we'll split by sampling_bucket and show an aggregate view defaulting to sampled_rate > 0.1. Need an API field to toggle "include unsampled" latencies.

Lina (platform): Rollout plan: 1) publish header contract doc, 2) runtime emits headers behind a feature flag, 3) Console reads new metrics and shows a preview in beta, 4) flip on by team. Also need a fallback for legacy clients that don't send model_variant — route_key is required.

Sergio (sre): Ops note: logs must include request_id and sampling_bucket so we can trace issues without hitting the trace backend for unsampled traffic. Log format suggestion: `req_id=%s sampling_bucket=%s route=%s`

Ajay (runtime): SGTM. Will open PR with header + metric names and an integration test. Expect initial rollout on canary traffic only.

DevDeployBot: Deployment queued: runtime/sampling-v2 will deploy to canary cluster in ~30m.

Maya (platform-ux): I'll mock up the Console panel and send screenshots by EOD. Lina, can you draft the header contract doc?

Lina (platform): Yes, I'll drop a draft in the doc channel and ping the thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
